description: This file defines reusable content components for a KeystoneJS project, including functions 'hint' and 'emoji' that create schema components with specific icons and options.

methods.name: hint
methods.description: Creates a schema component with a labeled wrapper, megaphone icon, and a select field for kind options ('tip', 'warn', 'error').

methods.name: emoji
methods.description: Creates an inline schema component with a smile icon and text fields for symbol and alt text.
